subject: APAC co-sell demo: contingency grid and backstop windows
messages:
From: Priya Menon <engage@astrasys.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Amy Li <amy.li@amazon.com>, Keiko Tanaka <keiko.tanaka@tokyo-med.jp>
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 09:12:00 +0900
Subject: [AstraSys] APAC pilot demo request + proposed ops grid
Attachments: AstraSys_runbook_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking this on. AstraSys is excited to co-present the integration with Redwood for the Tokyo Med pilot. We wanted to lock a demo window that works for the hospital's clinical ops (JST mornings) and still gives Redwood/APAC SI time for a deep technical handoff.

Proposed high-level windows (all JST):
- Option A: 09:00–10:00 (tight for customers, prefers short Q&A)
- Option B: 11:00–12:30 (preferred by our SRE/engineers)
- Option C: 15:00–16:30 (later but gives staggered prep time for US hosts)

I've attached a short runbook and a starter attendee matrix (CSV). Can we map the hosts and a contingency/backstop plan — e.g., who takes the host role if the primary AWS rep drops?

Low-friction asks:
1) Confirm which window Redwood can cover with a dedicated host + SI engineer.
2) Share any hard blackout times for Redwoods (APAC hosts).
3) If we need a fallback, can Redwood provide a pre-recorded segment we can cue?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min sync to finalize.

— Priya
Priya Menon
Partnerships, AstraSys Solutions

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Menon <engage@astrasys.com>
Cc: Amy Li <amy.li@amazon.com>, Keiko Tanaka <keiko.tanaka@tokyo-med.jp>, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 11:03:00 +0900
Subject: Re: [AstraSys] APAC pilot demo request + proposed ops grid

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear options and the runbook.

We can support Option B (11:00–12:30 JST) as our primary window. Vivek will be the Redwood lead; he can handle the tech walk and fallback orchestration. Vanessa and I will cover scheduling logistics and customer ops.

Quick notes:
- We have a soft blackout on 2026-09-10 to 2026-09-12 for capacity (team offsite). Avoid those dates.
- We can provide a 7-minute pre-recorded demo segment (MP4) as a backstop if a live host drops — we'll circulate that asset once the deck is finalized.

I pushed the attendee matrix back with some role columns filled (see attachments). Can you add the AstraSys engineer who will take primary SI host in the matrix?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Menon <engage@astrasys.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Amy Li <amy.li@amazon.com>, Keiko Tanaka <keiko.tanaka@tokyo-med.jp>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 12:18:00 +0900
Subject: Re: [AstraSys] APAC pilot demo request + proposed ops grid

Thanks Priya — I can take Redwood lead for Option B. A couple of ops asks from our side to make the contingency grid practical:

- Host rotation: please nominate a secondary SI host located in APAC (timezone overlap) who can step in at 30 minutes notice.
- Fallback region: if our primary AWS rep is unavailable, can Amy's team commit to standby for the first 30 minutes? (Amy, please confirm availability for a standby call window.)
- Network checks: can we schedule a 20-min run-through 48 hours prior with all hosts to validate VPN/Marketplace entitlements and SSO?

If everyone agrees, I'll draft a contingency grid mapping: primary host, secondary host, AWS standby, pre-record cue, and host contact numbers. I'll share by EOD JST.

-Vivek
Technical Partner Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Amy Li <amy.li@amazon.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, Priya Menon <engage@astrasys.com>
Cc: Keiko Tanaka <keiko.tanaka@tokyo-med.jp>
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 18:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: [AstraSys] APAC pilot demo request + proposed ops grid

Hi all — happy to standby for the first 30 minutes on Option B. Calendar note: my team can commit one engineer (Amy Li) and one solutions architect (AWS) for the primary event. We do have a Europe travel block the week of 2026-09-14, so that aligns with Kimberly's blackout.

Confirming the 48-hour network run-through is fine — please propose a 20-min slot and we'll book it. Also — recommend we build a very short FAQ doc for Tokyo Med ops (login flow, data partitioning note, who to call for latency). I can draft that if useful.

Regards,
Amy Li
Marketplace Partner Manager, AWS

From: Priya Menon <engage@astrasys.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amy Li <amy.li@amazon.com>, Keiko Tanaka <keiko.tanaka@tokyo-med.jp>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 09:05:00 +0900
Subject: Re: [AstraSys] APAC pilot demo request + proposed ops grid

Perfect — thanks everyone. I've updated the attendee_matrix_APAC.csv with the primary and a nominated secondary (Hideo Sato, AstraSys engineer, JST). I've also added Keiko as the clinical ops lead for Tokyo Med.

Next steps as I see them:
- Vivek: share the contingency grid draft (primary/secondary/AWS-standby/pre-record cue) by EOD JST today.
- Kimberly: can you confirm a 48-hour run-through slot? We prefer 2026-09-09 16:00–16:20 JST (which is 00:00–00:20 UTC). If that hits the Redwood blackout, propose an alternate.
- Amy: if you can draft the short Ops FAQ, that would be very helpful.

Attachments: attendee_matrix_APAC.csv

— Priya

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Menon <engage@astrasys.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Amy Li <amy.li@amazon.com>, Keiko Tanaka <keiko.tanaka@tokyo-med.jp>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 18:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [AstraSys] APAC pilot demo request + proposed ops grid

Folks — attaching the contingency grid (short table below) and confirming the run-through slot is problematic for us because of the offsite (we're in blackout 2026-09-10 through 2026-09-12). Proposed run-through alternatives (JST):
- Preferred run-through: 2026-09-07 16:00–16:20 JST
- Backstop run-through: 2026-09-08 09:00–09:20 JST

Contingency grid (summary):
- Primary host: Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood) — live tech walkthrough
- SI primary: Hideo Sato (AstraSys) — demo co-host and integrations Q&A
- SI secondary: Yumi Aoki (AstraSys) — standby for host takeover (30-min notice)
- Marketplace standby: Amy Li (AWS) — available first 30 minutes
- Pre-record cue: 7-minute MP4 (redwood-demo-deck-v3.pdf -> final MP4 to be delivered by Redwood)
- Run-through: 20-min technical check 48 hours prior (preferred above)

I will upload a short host contact sheet to the shared drive and mark the primary/backstop windows. Kimberly, Vanessa — if you confirm the demo date (we're penciling 2026-09-09 JST Option B), I'll lock calendar invites and include the run-through.

-Vivek
Technical Partner Lead | Redwood Inference
